g.text: Where to filter Swarm ports when peers connect over Tailscale
The cloud (VPC) firewall only ever sees the OUTER encrypted packets. Filter on tailscale0 inside the machine.
outer packet (what the cloud sees): src = the peer's PUBLIC IP, UDP 41641 or DERP over TCP 443, encrypted
inner packet (what ufw sees after decryption): src 100.x.y.z, dst 2377/tcp
Do NOT open 2377 / 7946 / 4789 in the cloud firewall.
Optional: allow inbound UDP 41641 so Tailscale can connect directly.
DO restrict them in the host firewall to tailscale0:
plain `ufw allow 2377/tcp` opens the port on EVERY interface.
